summary: Primary Chat now actually loads the existing CURRENT-first projection and that projection is aligned with the canonical state-communication contract. It exposes REFILL_N, buffer, worker liveness, claimables, current human action and last durable human-action timestamp without becoming a scheduler or replacing runtime/frontier owners. RETURNS_UNCONSUMED and RECOVERY_PRESSURE now require a live consumer, so they no longer suppress REFILL_N when useful work exists but live capacity is zero.
